bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖反弹，重回 $54.8 上方

read.en: Intel rose 7.7% on Nov 6 to $56.28, trading $54.56–57.32. It is below the falling 5-day ($57.5), 10-day ($72.5), 30-day ($93.6) and 100-day ($101.8) and the rising 200-day ($87.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($87.02), and RSI is 26, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月6日上涨 7.7%，收于 $56.28，盘中区间 $54.56–57.32。股价位于下行的 5 日（$57.5）、10 日（$72.5）、30 日（$93.6）和 100 日均线（$101.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.0）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$87.02），RSI 为 26，处于超卖。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $53.1–54.8 area (Jan 22 range, Apr 8 low), now support, but the $57.32 high stalled under the 5-day. Resistance is $56.8–57.5 (Nov 4 low, 5-day), then $58.3–60.2 and $62.6 (Nov 3 high). Support is $54.6–54.8, then $51.5–51.7 and $50. A close above $57.5 would target $58–60; below $54.6, $51.5.

r.en: Nov 4 close $58.3; Apr 9 low $58.4; Nov 4 high $60.2

s.en: Nov 6 low $54.56; Apr 8 low $54.8; Jan 22 high $54.6, reclaimed
